title: Find sign-ins that still use legacy authentication
summary: Before you block legacy authentication: who still signs in with IMAP, POP, SMTP AUTH, ActiveSync or other legacy clients, interactive and non-interactive.
code:
// Entra sign-in logs in Log Analytics / Microsoft Sentinel
union SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(ClientAppUsed)
| where ClientAppUsed !in ("Browser", "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients")
| summarize SignIns = count(), Succeeded = countif(ResultType == "0"), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by UserPrincipalName, ClientAppUsed, AppDisplayName
| order by SignIns desc
notes: Needs the SignInLogs and NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs categories sent to a Log Analytics workspace (diagnostic settings).
Browser and 'Mobile Apps and Desktop clients' are the modern-auth client types; everything else in ClientAppUsed is legacy.
